title: Retry failed cnf lemma searches over a z3 unsat core of the gates
summary: When the propositional search for a cnf lemma gives up, the Lean reconstructor now asks z3 for an unsat core of the lemma's propositional abstraction and searches again over the core's gates only, with Lean still checking every step. This proves the failing cnf lemma of QF_IDL planning/plan-21 and, under a reduced budget, all seven cnf lemmas of FISCHER6-4.
